name: CHAOS SPACE MARINES: CHAOS RHINO
description: Chaos Rhinos are ancient workhorse transport vehicles that have served Humanity for millennia. Though encrusted with heretical icons and corrupted by the Warp, they remain as rugged and reliable as ever, safely carrying their passengers over fire-swept battlefields.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Chaos Rhino for your Chaos Space Marines, World Eaters, Emperor's Children, Death Guard, or Thousand Sons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. The transport vehicle adds mobility by ensuring your Chaos infantry gets to where you need them – be they frothing Berzerkers, indomitable Plague Marines, overstimulated Noise Marines, sorcery fuelled Rubric Marines, or heavily armed Havocs.</br></br>There are plenty of cosmetic options to customise your vehicle, including a variety of Chaos icons, trophy racks, chains, hooks, dozer spikes, and corrupted armour plates. In addition to its armoured bulk, the Chaos Rhino is armed with a pintle-mounted combi-bolter or combi-weapon, and includes options for a Chaos Space Marine gunner or a closed hatch. It can also sport an optional rooftop havoc launcher for additional long-ranged firepower.</br></br>This kit comprises 114 plastic components. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
